'''Jurgorans''' were large, amphibious animals native to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where they were challenged only by the [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] for a position at the top of the food chain. They were known for their sharp claws and tough hides,<ref name="TOR" /> and they had been transplanted to several worlds across the galaxy. On [[Taral V]], several jurgorans attacked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike team that was trying to gain information on a [[Revan/Legends|missing Jedi]].<ref name="flashpoint video" />

==History==
{{Quote|My pets are ready to play. Are you?|Rora Seake, on her jurgorans|<ref name="Codex" />}}
On Dromund Kaas, the jurgoran became the image of vicious, unrelenting strength among the Sith who first came to the world, and many Sith had taken the name "Lord Jurgoran" throughout the Empire's history.<ref name="TOR" />

The Sith assassin [[Rora Seake]] also used two Jurgorans as "pets" during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They, along with their master, met their ends on Taris at the hands of a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] who was defending Seake's target, a Republic colony.

A jurgoran somehow made its way to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], the ancient home of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="TOR" /> It is unknown how the animal arrived on the planet, or if any more existed there. The jurgoran in question lived near the ruins of [[Vur Tepe]], the Forge, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It slumbered in a cave in the ravine near the Forge until it was accidentally awoken around [[3643 BBY]] by a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Padawan]] who had just saved their master [[Orgus Din]] from the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]]. The jurgoran, known as the [[Forge Guardian]], was killed by the Padawan when it attacked them, having been disturbed by the Padawan's crafting of their new [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
